propositions.proposition: Helion Robotics Ltd is the operating name used in CRM, while invoices and Companies House use Helion Robotics Limited, and those name forms refer to the same legal entity.
propositions.relevance: The contract counterparty is named Helion Robotics Ltd.; the left referent is billing:Helion Robotics Limited. This observation explicitly states that the Ltd and Limited name forms denote one legal entity, linking the contract-side name to the billing-side name.

propositions.proposition: Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from Helion Robotics; it sold sensors in 2018 and has no current MSA.
propositions.relevance: Preserves that a separately named Helion-titled entity is not the counterparty tied to billing:Helion Robotics Limited or contract:MSA-HELION-2019, reducing risk of conflating similarly named parties.

propositions.proposition: Billing records show the billed name Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the left referent billing:Helion Robotics Limited to the legal counterparty name used on invoices.

propositions.proposition: A second billing record also shows the billed name Helion Robotics Limited.
propositions.relevance: Corroborates that billing:Helion Robotics Limited consistently denotes Helion Robotics Limited across invoice rows.

propositions.proposition: Master services agreement MSA-HELION-2019 lists Counterparty: Helion Robotics Ltd.
propositions.relevance: Grounds the right referent contract:MSA-HELION-2019 to the legal counterparty named on that agreement, which must be compared against billing:Helion Robotics Limited.
